name: al-lsp-for-agents
description: Code navigation, call hierarchy, and code quality diagnostics for AL (Business Central) — works with GitHub Copilot agent mode

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_goToDefinition
languageModelTools.userDescription: Navigate to where an AL symbol is defined
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigate to where an AL symbol is defined. Use this when you need to find the source definition of a table, codeunit, procedure, field, enum, page, or any other AL object. Provide a file URI and position (line/character). Returns the file and location of the definition.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_hover
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get type info, signatures, and field lists for AL symbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get type information, procedure signatures, and record field lists for an AL symbol. Use this to understand what type a variable is, what fields a record has, or what parameters a procedure takes. Provide a file URI and position.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_findReferences
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find all usages of an AL symbol across the project
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find all usages of an AL symbol across the project. Returns every file and location where the symbol is referenced. Use this before renaming or modifying a symbol to understand impact.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_prepareCallHierarchy
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get call hierarchy item at a cursor position
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a call hierarchy item at a cursor position in an AL file. Use this to identify a procedure for subsequent incoming/outgoing call analysis. Provide a file URI and position on a procedure name.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_incomingCalls
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find all callers of an AL procedure
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find all procedures that call a specific AL procedure (its callers). Provide a file URI and position on a procedure name. Returns a list of calling procedures with their locations.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_outgoingCalls
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find all procedures called by an AL procedure
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find all procedures that a specific AL procedure calls (its callees). Provide a file URI and position on a procedure name. Returns a list of called procedures with their locations.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_codeLens
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get reference counts for procedures in an AL file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get reference counts for all procedures in an AL file. Returns code lens items showing how many callers each procedure has. Use this to quickly identify unused or heavily-used procedures.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_codeQualityDiagnostics
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get code quality diagnostics: unused procs, complexity, etc.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get code quality diagnostics for AL files: unused procedures (no callers), high cyclomatic complexity, too many parameters, high fan-in, and long methods. Use this to identify code smells and improvement opportunities. Optionally filter by file URI.

uri.description: File URI (file:///path/to/file.al) to filter diagnostics for a specific file, or omit for all files

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_documentSymbols
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the symbol tree for an AL file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the symbol tree for an AL file. Returns all objects, procedures, fields, actions, and variables with their hierarchy. Use this to understand file structure before reading or editing.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_renameSymbol
languageModelTools.userDescription: Rename an AL symbol across all files in the workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename an AL symbol at a given position, applying changes across all files in the workspace. Provide a file URI, position on the symbol, and the new name. Use this for safe refactoring of procedure names, variable names, and other symbols.

newName.description: The new name for the symbol

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_symbolSearch
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search AL symbols with rich filtering (objects and members)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search AL symbols (objects and members) by matching query text against symbol names. Supports rich filtering by object kind, member kind, container object name, namespace, and scope. Use filters.memberKinds=['Method','Field'] to find procedures and fields. Use filters.objectName='Customer' with filters.memberKinds=['Field'] to list fields of a specific table. Use query='*' as wildcard when relying on filters. Returns symbol name, kind, container, signature, and file path.

query.description: Required text to search in symbol names. Use a broad term (e.g., 'Customer', 'Post') or '*' as wildcard when using filters.

kinds.description: Object kinds to include: Table, Codeunit, Page, Report, Enum, Query, XmlPort, Interface, PermissionSet, Profile, Entitlement, PageExtension, TableExtension, EnumExtension, ReportExtension, PermissionSetExtension, PageCustomization

objectName.description: Exact container name for filtering members only (e.g., 'Customer' to find methods/fields inside Customer). Do NOT use to find the object itself—use query with kinds instead.

memberKinds.description: Member kinds: Method, Field, Key, Action
